description: Pico CSS 2, classless styles for semantic HTML
agents: Styles: Pico CSS 2. Entry `src/app/styles/styles.scss`, compiled by YASSB's Sass from `node_modules/@picocss/pico/scss`. Pico styles semantic HTML without classes: `header`, `main` and `footer` directly inside `body` are centred containers; write plain elements (`nav > ul`, `article`, `button`, forms) and add classes only when needed.
